name: tencent-docs
description: Operate Tencent Docs (docs.qq.com) online documents: create smart docs/Word/Excel/slides/mind maps/flowcharts, search and read content, manage spaces, OCR. Wraps the official HTTP MCP endpoint; requires the TENCENT_DOCS_TOKEN environment variable.

description_i18n.en: Operate Tencent Docs (docs.qq.com) online documents: create smart docs/Word/Excel/slides/mind maps/flowcharts, search and read content, manage spaces, OCR. Wraps the official HTTP MCP endpoint; requires the TENCENT_DOCS_TOKEN environment variable.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 操作腾讯文档（docs.qq.com）在线文档：创建智能文档/Word/Excel/幻灯片/思维导图/流程图，搜索与读取内容，管理知识库空间，OCR。封装官方 HTTP MCP 端点；需要环境变量 TENCENT_DOCS_TOKEN。
